title: Deep-learning detection system finds early neoplasia in Barrett's esophagus images
summary: A computer-aided detection system trained on 1713 neoplastic and 2707 non-dysplastic images from 15 hospitals was tested on three independent sets. Sensitivity was 84% on subtle lesions, where 52 general endoscopists reached 63%, and 100% and 88% on the other two sets; specificity was 64-66%.
ai_technology: Deep-learning computer-aided detection on endoscopic images
organization: Amsterdam Gastroenterology Endocrinology Metabolism; University of Amsterdam

evidence.tested: Three independent image test sets, one prospectively collected.
evidence.unknown: Image-based, small test sets; early development step; full text not reviewed.
